title: Begin
subtitle: The entry node, and the only one named
description: An available node here is a light grey, and the ring on hover is the brightest white
in the theme. Every distinction on this canvas is one of brightness.
Look at the connector line to the node above: it is a mid grey, which is brighter than
the blocked outline and dimmer than the available one. Those three values have to sit
in the right order for this theme to work at all.
